1. Our Principles
 1.1 All employees are expected to act with integrity, respect colleagues, protect company assets and
 comply with applicable law.
2. Conflict of Interest
 2.1 Employees must disclose any financial interest in a vendor, customer or competitor to their manager
 and Compliance within 10 working days of becoming aware of it.
2.2 Outside employment requires written approval from the Head of Compliance.
 
3. Gifts and Hospitality

2.2 Outside employment requires written approval from the Head of Compliance.
 
3. Gifts and Hospitality
 3.1 Employees may accept gifts from vendors, customers or partners with a combined value of up to INR
 5,000 per calendar year per giver. Cash or cash equivalents (including gift cards) must always be
declined.
3.2 Any gift above INR 5,000 must be declined or surrendered to Compliance and recorded in the Gifts
 Register.
4. Harassment and Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH)
 4.1 Northwind has zero tolerance for harassment. Complaints may be raised with the Internal Committee
 (IC) at ic@northwind.example.
4.2 Complaints must be raised within 3 months of the incident, extendable by a further 3 months for good
 cause, in line with the POSH Act.
5. Confidentiality and Social Media

cause, in line with the POSH Act.
5. Confidentiality and Social Media
 5.1 Employees must not disclose confidential company, customer or colleague information, including on
 social media. Personal opinions must not be presented as company positions.
6. Speaking Up (Whistleblower)
 6.1 Concerns about suspected misconduct can be raised confidentially at ethics@northwind.example or
 on the 24x7 Ethics Hotline 1800-000-0000. Retaliation against a good-faith reporter is strictly
prohibited.
7. Disciplinary Action
 7.1 Breaches may result in a verbal warning, written warning, suspension, or termination depending on
 severity. Serious misconduct (fraud, harassment, data theft) may lead to immediate termination.

1. Purpose
 1.1 This policy sets out the hybrid working model at Northwind Technologies and the conditions under
 which employees may work remotely.
2. Eligibility
 2.1 Employees are eligible for hybrid work after successfully completing the 6-month probation period.
 2.2 Roles marked 'On-site Only' in the job description (for example Facilities, Lab Engineering and
 Reception) are not eligible.
3. Hybrid Schedule

2.2 Roles marked 'On-site Only' in the job description (for example Facilities, Lab Engineering and
 Reception) are not eligible.
3. Hybrid Schedule
 3.1 Eligible employees may work from home up to 2 days per week. The remaining days must be worked
 from a company office.
3.2 Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 16:00 IST. Employees must be reachable on Teams during
 these hours.
3.3 Fully remote arrangements require written approval from the Vice President of the function and the
 CHRO, and are reviewed every 6 months.
4. WFH Allowance and Equipment
 4.1 A monthly WFH allowance of INR 1,500 is paid with salary to employees on the hybrid schedule.
 4.2 Employees may request one monitor and one keyboard from IT for home use. Equipment remains
 company property.
5. Security Requirements

4.2 Employees may request one monitor and one keyboard from IT for home use. Equipment remains
 company property.
5. Security Requirements
 5.1 Employees must connect through the corporate VPN (GlobalProtect) at all times when accessing
 internal systems from home.
5.2 Work must not be carried out on public Wi-Fi without VPN. See IT-SEC-003 and IT-DEV-002 for
 further requirements.
6. Approval Process
 6.1 Hybrid days are agreed with the Reporting Manager and recorded in HRMS. Ad-hoc additional WFH
 days (for example for emergencies) require same-day manager approval and are limited to 4 days
per quarter.

1. Scope
 1.1 This policy describes how approved employee expenses and advances are paid back or settled.
 
2. Claim Submission Window
 2.1 Claims must be submitted within 45 days of the expense date or the end of the trip, whichever is later.
 2.2 Claims submitted after 60 days require a written exception approved by the CFO.
 
3. Processing and Payment
 3.1 Approved claims are paid by bank transfer within 10 business days of final approval.

3. Processing and Payment
 3.1 Approved claims are paid by bank transfer within 10 business days of final approval.
 3.2 Claims are processed in weekly payment runs every Friday.
 
4. Travel Advances
 4.1 Employees may request an advance of up to 80% of the estimated trip cost on Form FIN-210, at least
 5 working days before departure.
4.2 Advances must be settled within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered from the next
 salary.
5. Foreign Currency
 5.1 Expenses incurred in foreign currency are converted at the company treasury rate on the date of the
 transaction, not the card statement rate.
6. Rejected Claims and Appeals
 6.1 Rejected claims may be appealed to the Finance Controller within 15 days of rejection. The decision
 on appeal is final.
